title: ZDD repo config (zdd/config.json)
description: Per-repo ZDD configuration: which extractors to run, where the artifacts live, and per-extractor source paths. Artifact CONTENTS never live here — this is the small, portable config tier only.
$comment: Exactly one config tier: `extractors` (+ extractorOptions) OR the deprecated `adapter` (+ adapterOptions). The engine refuses a config carrying both, and so does this schema.

extractors.description: Extractors to run, composed: one per convention in the stack (built-in: supabase, nextjs, fastapi, react-router, components, expo-router, jobs, generic). Selected by NAME from the engine's registry or from localExtractorDir — never by path. Records from every extractor are merged and cross-extractor refs resolved after the merge.

extractorOptions.description: Per-extractor source configuration, keyed by extractor name. Built-ins are described below; a local extractor's options are whatever its module documents. Every path is repo-relative POSIX — absolute paths and '..' are refused at runtime.

migrationNamespaces.description: One entry per database: SQL migrations under `dir` (non-recursive) replay into namespace `name`.

externalBuckets.description: Storage buckets that exist but were never created by a migration here.

middlewarePath.description: middleware.ts whose config.matcher decides session auth.

srcAliasRoot.description: Where the tsconfig @/ alias points; default appDir's parent.

refs.description: Source files scanned for outbound references. Any omitted field takes its default.

subscribeCalls.description: Call names whose first string argument is a table a page subscribes to over Supabase Realtime, beside .on("postgres_changes", { table }) — a `subscribes` edge (ZDD 2.1).

roots.description: Files or directories scanned for .py handlers.

routesFile.description: The file declaring the route tree in code: a RouteObject[] / createBrowserRouter([...]) array, or <Route> elements. One surface per route with a path; layout ancestors become facts.guards.

srcAliasRoot.description: Where the tsconfig @/ alias points; default the routes file's directory.

subscribeCalls.description: Call names whose first string argument is a table the screen subscribes to over Supabase Realtime (e.g. "live.onInsert"), beside the client's own .on("postgres_changes", { table }) — a `subscribes` edge (ZDD 2.1).

components.description: React and React Native components (ZDD 2.1, opt-in): exported capitalised functions returning JSX in .tsx/.jsx files under roots. Pages and screens under pageDirs stay the routing extractors'. A component is shared when two or more files import it or it sits under a sharedDirs folder.

pageDirs.description: Folder names whose files are surfaces (pages, screens), not components.

sharedDirs.description: Folder names that mark every component under them shared, whatever its import count.

srcAliasRoot.description: Where the tsconfig @/ alias points; default the first root.

expo-router.description: Native screens from an Expo Router file tree (ZDD 2.1, opt-in, early): one surface per screen file under appDir, namespaced `surface:native:/path` so a native screen and a web page may share a URL; _layout files are layouts; (group) folders are stripped; [id] is dynamic.

srcAliasRoot.description: Where the tsconfig @/ alias points; default appDir's parent.

jobs.description: Workers and scheduled jobs from committed run manifests (ZDD 2.1, opt-in, decision 0020): package.json scripts that run a module as a process (python -m x, node x.mjs), Procfile lines, railway.toml/json startCommand (+ cronSchedule = scheduled). The mode is never guessed: scheduled from a Railway file, worker from `modes`, else unknown with a lint warning.

roots.description: Where manifests are looked for; node_modules and .git are never entered.

exclude.description: Script names that are not jobs. Default: dev, start, test, lint, build, typecheck, format, prepare, postinstall, and anything test:*, lint:*, build:*, check:*.

modes.description: The mode of a job the manifests do not state, by job name.

file.description: A JS/TS entry file, relative to cwd.

cwd.description: The folder the command runs in (default the repo root).

localExtractorDir.description: Repo-relative directory holding repo-local extractors (<name>.mjs or <name>/index.mjs), each selectable by name in `extractors`. The one place config may point at code; a one-off convention lives here instead of in a fork, and the plugin's `extractor` skill scaffolds one here. Local names may not shadow built-ins.

adapter.description: DEPRECATED (pre-1.0): the single monolithic adapter. Still honoured — `nextjs-supabase` expands to extractors [supabase, nextjs] with adapterOptions split by key — but prints a deprecation note on every derive; `bootstrap --upgrade` migrates it for you.

adapterOptions.description: DEPRECATED (pre-1.0): options for the single `adapter`. Use extractorOptions.

engine.description: The @rich-rees/zdd-engine version this repo was bootstrapped for — written by bootstrap, rewritten by bootstrap --upgrade, compared against the plugin by load (skew warning). Mirrors the pin in the CI workflow / pre-push hook so a repo without CI still has one.

hooks.description: The hook opt-ins recorded by bootstrap. The plugin's hooks.json registers all three hooks for every repo and each script reads this block to decide whether to act, so opting in or out is a config change, not a host-settings change.

autoLoad.description: SessionStart: inject the agent index. Absent means on (pre-opt-in repos keep loading).

fence.description: PreToolUse: refuse hand edits (Write/Edit and write-shaped shell) to the generated artifacts at their configured paths. Only an explicit true fences.

stop.description: Stop (plugin 1.1+): when the agent ends a turn with code changed against the base branch and nothing in the ZDD bundle moved, block once per session with a one-line prompt to run the finish ritual or state that nothing met the three-part test. A prompt for the curated half, not a check. Only an explicit true enables it.

name.description: Display name for the indexes (agent-index heading, human-index title).

repoBase.description: GitHub tree URL prefix for source links in the human index, e.g. https://github.com/org/repo/tree/main/. Empty = relative links. Must be http(s) — the renderer refuses anything else, since it becomes every source link's scheme.

nonAreaTags.description: Tags that are properties rather than product areas (tech tags like react-flow, rls-disabled). A metadata record inherits its area from the first tag of its claiming feature that is NOT listed here — this shapes graph.json, which is why it is top-level and not a viewer option. The pre-0.4 home, viewer.nonAreaTags, is still read with a deprecation note.

baseBranch.description: The branch PRs merge into. Freshness diffs and the renderer's changed-set highlight key on origin/<baseBranch>.

paths.description: Where each artifact lives. Defaults are the self-contained zdd/* layout; point elsewhere only if adopting an existing glossary/ADR directory.

blessingIndex.description: One line per blessing in the semantic map, by trigger question, read whole when choosing patterns — generated, checked by render --check.

patternsPlan.description: The branch's pattern plan, written by "choose patterns" and reconciled and deleted by "update ZDD"; lint --merge (CI) fails while it exists.

graph.description: The graph artifact (schema zdd-graph/1) the human index is rendered from — generated, checked by render --check.

bundleDir.description: The folder graph node ids are relative to — the zdd/ folder itself.

storeChanges.description: Set false to render with no git dependency — drops the 'what just changed' highlight from the human index.

claims.description: How `lint` treats feature claims on routes, tables, functions and surfaces (a Feature slice claims a record by linking it). Off by default: unclaimed and double-claimed records are warnings. Unknown keys are refused — a misspelt 'strict' must never leave enforcement silently off.

strict.description: true: every claimable record belongs to exactly one feature slice. An unclaimed record not in allowUnclaimed, an allowUnclaimed id that names no record, and a record claimed by two or more slices all FAIL lint.

allowUnclaimed.description: Record ids that may stay unclaimed under strict — plumbing no feature owns. Read only when strict is true.

agentIndex.description: Renderer options for the agent index (e.g. the blockquote summary line).

viewer.description: Which viewer renders the human index from the graph artifact, and its options. A name (built-in: cytoscape, minimal) or an object whose `name` selects the viewer and whose other keys are its options — for cytoscape: defaultFocus, authHubs, nonAreaTags. An object without `name` (the pre-registry shape) means cytoscape.

defaultFocus.description: cytoscape: node id the explorer view opens on.

authHubs.description: cytoscape: node ids whose edges to ordinary session-auth endpoints are stated, not drawn.

componentFanIn.description: cytoscape: a UI component used by this many surfaces or components, or more, draws its edges only on hover in the lanes view and shows a count instead — the design-system primitive rule (ZDD 2.1). A viewer choice: graph.json is unchanged.

nonAreaTags.description: DEPRECATED (pre-0.4 home): move to the top-level nonAreaTags key — it shapes graph.json, not just this viewer. Still honoured with a note.
